authority.interpretation: D-087 delegates safe disposition of exactly the purpose-created synthetic fixture scope and requires preservation of necessary anti-resurrection evidence; it does not prescribe hard deletion or authorize bypassing retention guards. Retaining the exact new fixture IDs with verified fixed account bans, global sign-out attempts and token denial/expiry evidence is the scoped disposition prepared here. This is an explicit interpretation for root review, not a claim that the document says 'retain' verbatim.
authority.retentionInterpretationReviewed: Root reviewed the exact D-087 source and accepted this bounded retention disposition on 2026-10-12; activation remains pending the actual prepared N58 gate.

forbidden: arbitrary SQL or URLs in the handler

disposition.globalSignOut: separate operation, using a server-verified fixture user access JWT; record result independently
disposition.banVerification: fresh exact admin GET, unchanged app_metadata.d087 and future banned_until; do not resend a relative ban if already verified
disposition.accessJwt: Existing JWT remains potentially usable until its exp; record maximum issued fixture token expiry and close only the three owned contexts.
disposition.tokenDenial: Private password sign-in should return user_banned; prior refresh tokens should return refresh_token_not_found/refresh_token_already_used or user_banned, with exact response code and no token data in public receipt.
disposition.finalFunction: Two new operations functions (provision and predeployed cleanup-only companion) redeployed to closed-entry.ts; verify both exact denied endpoints and provider source metadata. If MCP/model is unavailable this is DISARM_PENDING, even after safe Auth retention.
disposition.successLabel: RETAINED_BANNED with actual per-account sign-out/token evidence; never CLEAN, DELETED, Product CLOSED or N58 Production

execution.scope: root-reviewed bounded operations job outside Product catalog
execution.currentImplementation: Handler provisions/verifies/revokes/retires only Auth fixtures. Runner does no Product mutation and does not claim the separate N58 client/browser gate executed.
execution.cleanupPreparation: Deploy and protected-probe the separate cleanup-only companion before allowing any Auth create. Actual sign-out/ban/token-denial finally runs directly via Node HTTP without an MCP/model redeploy step. Both capabilities expire after 90 minutes; explicit deny-all redeploy/source verification remains a separate final step, not guaranteed by expiry.
execution.remainingOwnedWork: Build the fresh N58 integration and a deterministic single A1/A2/B1 live harness before provisioning. No accounts are created just to prove Auth capability.
